import numpy as np
import json
from scipy import stats

# Load actual data
with open('results/round7_seed_level_stats.json') as f:
    r7 = json.load(f)
with open('results/exp39_extra_seeds.json') as f:
    e39 = json.load(f)

# Build 5-seed F1 arrays [s42, s123, s456, s789, s1000]
nine_dd = [r7['per_seed_f1']['9-class']['DD']['42'], r7['per_seed_f1']['9-class']['DD']['123'], r7['per_seed_f1']['9-class']['DD']['456'], e39['9class_seed789']['dd_ood'], e39['9class_seed1000']['dd_ood']]
nine_aa = [r7['per_seed_f1']['9-class']['AA']['42'], r7['per_seed_f1']['9-class']['AA']['123'], r7['per_seed_f1']['9-class']['AA']['456'], e39['9class_seed789']['aa_ood'], e39['9class_seed1000']['aa_ood']]
nine_fitd = [r7['per_seed_f1']['9-class']['FITD']['42'], r7['per_seed_f1']['9-class']['FITD']['123'], r7['per_seed_f1']['9-class']['FITD']['456'], e39['9class_seed789']['fitd_ood'], e39['9class_seed1000']['fitd_ood']]

scr_dd = [r7['per_seed_f1']['Scrambled']['DD']['42'], r7['per_seed_f1']['Scrambled']['DD']['123'], r7['per_seed_f1']['Scrambled']['DD']['456'], e39['scrambled_seed789']['dd_ood'], e39['scrambled_seed1000']['dd_ood']]
scr_aa = [r7['per_seed_f1']['Scrambled']['AA']['42'], r7['per_seed_f1']['Scrambled']['AA']['123'], r7['per_seed_f1']['Scrambled']['AA']['456'], e39['scrambled_seed789']['aa_ood'], e39['scrambled_seed1000']['aa_ood']]
scr_fitd = [r7['per_seed_f1']['Scrambled']['FITD']['42'], r7['per_seed_f1']['Scrambled']['FITD']['123'], r7['per_seed_f1']['Scrambled']['FITD']['456'], e39['scrambled_seed789']['fitd_ood'], e39['scrambled_seed1000']['fitd_ood']]

print("="*70)
print("5-seed F1 values (seeds: 42, 123, 456, 789, 1000)")
print("="*70)
for name, nc, sc in [('DD', nine_dd, scr_dd), ('AA', nine_aa, scr_aa), ('FITD', nine_fitd, scr_fitd)]:
    nc_str = '[' + ', '.join(f'{v:.4f}' for v in nc) + ']'
    sc_str = '[' + ', '.join(f'{v:.4f}' for v in sc) + ']'
    print(f"{name:5s} 9-class {nc_str}  scrambled {sc_str}")

def tost_paired(x, y, margin=0.05):
    diff = np.array(x) - np.array(y)
    n = len(diff)
    mean_diff = np.mean(diff)
    se = np.std(diff, ddof=1) / np.sqrt(n)
    if se == 0:
        if abs(mean_diff) < margin:
            return {'mean_diff': float(mean_diff), 'se': 0.0, 'p_tost': 0.0,
                    'p_upper': 0.0, 'p_lower': 0.0, 't_upper': float('-inf'),
                    't_lower': float('inf'), 'n': n, 'margin': margin, 'equivalent': True,
                    'note': 'SE=0, differences identical, trivially equivalent'}
        else:
            return {'mean_diff': float(mean_diff), 'se': 0.0, 'p_tost': 1.0,
                    'p_upper': 1.0, 'p_lower': 1.0, 't_upper': float('inf'),
                    't_lower': float('-inf'), 'n': n, 'margin': margin, 'equivalent': False,
                    'note': 'SE=0, mean_diff outside margin'}
    t_upper = (mean_diff - margin) / se
    p_upper = stats.t.cdf(t_upper, df=n-1)
    t_lower = (mean_diff + margin) / se
    p_lower = 1 - stats.t.cdf(t_lower, df=n-1)
    p_tost = max(p_upper, p_lower)
    return {
        'mean_diff': float(mean_diff),
        'se': float(se),
        'p_tost': float(p_tost),
        'p_upper': float(p_upper),
        'p_lower': float(p_lower),
        't_upper': float(t_upper),
        't_lower': float(t_lower),
        'n': n,
        'margin': margin,
        'equivalent': p_tost < 0.05
    }

def cohens_d(x, y):
    diff = np.array(x) - np.array(y)
    sd = np.std(diff, ddof=1)
    if sd == 0:
        return 0.0 if np.mean(diff) == 0 else float('inf')
    return float(np.mean(diff) / sd)

print("\n" + "="*70)
print("TOST Equivalence Test (paired, epsilon=0.05)")
print("="*70)
print(f"{'Condition':<10} {'mean_diff':>10} {'SE':>8} {'p_TOST':>8} {'Cohen d':>9} {'Equivalent?':>12}")
print("-"*60)

results_out = {
    'f1_values': {
        '9-class': {'DD': nine_dd, 'AA': nine_aa, 'FITD': nine_fitd},
        'Scrambled': {'DD': scr_dd, 'AA': scr_aa, 'FITD': scr_fitd}
    },
    'seeds': [42, 123, 456, 789, 1000],
    'tost_results': {},
    'margin': 0.05,
    'test': 'paired TOST (two one-sided t-tests)',
    'note': '9-class minus Scrambled'
}

for name, x, y in [('DD', nine_dd, scr_dd), ('AA', nine_aa, scr_aa), ('FITD', nine_fitd, scr_fitd)]:
    result = tost_paired(x, y, margin=0.05)
    d = cohens_d(x, y)
    eq_str = 'YES' if result['equivalent'] else 'NO'
    print(f"{name:<10} {result['mean_diff']:>10.4f} {result['se']:>8.4f} {result['p_tost']:>8.4f} {d:>9.4f} {eq_str:>12}")
    result['cohens_d'] = d
    result['9class_values'] = x
    result['scrambled_values'] = y
    results_out['tost_results'][name] = result

# Also print detailed per-condition info
for name in ['DD', 'AA', 'FITD']:
    r = results_out['tost_results'][name]
    print(f"\n--- {name} detail ---")
    print(f"  9-class mean: {np.mean(r['9class_values']):.4f}, Scrambled mean: {np.mean(r['scrambled_values']):.4f}")
    print(f"  p_upper={r['p_upper']:.6f}, p_lower={r['p_lower']:.6f}")
    if 'note' in r:
        print(f"  note: {r['note']}")

with open('results/exp39_tost_analysis.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(results_out, f, indent=2, default=str)
print("\nSaved to results/exp39_tost_analysis.json")
PYEOF
